# Redbear Publishing

> Redbear Publishing publishes science fiction, fantasy, and comics: Actionopolis chapter books, Spectrum comics from Con Man, Komikwerks graphic novels, and PJ Haarsma's Softwire novels.

Redbear Publishing is an independent publisher of fantastical worlds and page-turning stories. Use this file to find the official catalog, then open a title page for the description, formats, and purchase link.

Contact: [info@redbearpublishing.com](mailto:info@redbearpublishing.com) or [(323) 620-2327](tel:+13236202327). Studio site: [redbear.tv](https://redbear.tv).

## Site

- [Home](https://redbearpublishing.com/): Softwire novels and publisher introduction
- [Actionopolis books](https://redbearpublishing.com/category/actionopolis/): Middle-grade and young-adult Actionopolis titles
- [Comics](https://redbearpublishing.com/comics/): Spectrum issues and Komikwerks graphic novels
- [Sitemap](https://redbearpublishing.com/sitemap.xml): Complete list of public pages
- [AI catalog](https://redbearpublishing.com/.well-known/ai-catalog.json): Machine-readable catalog for agents
